design.identity: Hunched pale cold-grey stone guardian with a pointed bird-skull mask and tiny green eyes, huge arched back stone loop, mossy cracks, ribbed chest, circular oath carvings; RIGHT arm/viewer-left is a curved stone scythe; left hand grips a long carved stone slab. Two angular stone feet.
design.attack: Coil torso strongly backward, lift scythe above skull then sweep low in one full heavy arc toward LEFT, left slab braces, recoil and settle.
design.cast: Wake: bow mask almost to chest, deeply hinge knees, arch back loop high, raise both slab and scythe overhead; oath grooves flare green then a huge stone-energy shockwave; recover.
design.death: Cracks spread through joints, shoulders shear, knees buckle and heavy stone plates fall apart into a stable rubble pile; no vanishing, final frame rubble.

design.identity: Giant folded-wing kite raptor, hooked beak, grey-green feathers with one faded side, forest green wing coverts, nest twigs wrapped around talons, asymmetric shortened tail. Exactly two bird legs and two large feathered wings.
design.attack: Three distinct fast forward beak strikes with neck recoil, talons braced, strong shoulder follow-through; end in folded-wing stance.
design.cast: Deep crouch then huge fully spread wing upstroke, powerful aerial lift and long LEFT swooping dive with talons extended, wing brake and land back at origin.
design.death: Wings lose lift, body pitches down, lands on side, feathers settle; retain a coherent fallen bird.

design.identity: Huge squat green frog with charcoal mottling, pale bulging belly, exactly four legs, dorsal purple spore sacs containing tiny larval silhouettes, hanging cheek bubbles; broad amphibian mouth.
design.attack: Inflate throat then lash a long flexible tongue four times toward LEFT, distinct body recoil; hind feet brace.
design.cast: Compress all four legs, inflate dorsal sacs and throat hugely, arch whole body and expel a broad fan of green-purple spores from opened sacs; settle without losing sacs.
design.death: Back sacs deflate, legs fold and frog sinks on its side, non-gory stable corpse with closed eyes.

design.identity: Long spectral graveyard-waterway eel, slate grey blue body, pale underside, moss-like grey aquatic weed mantle, three tarnished copper grave tags, small fin ears and a curled lower tail, no humanoid limbs.
design.attack: Wind upper body into a tight S then bite and whip head strongly toward LEFT, wave travels down tail and returns.
design.cast: Tail remains anchored while body coils down then unfurls to nearly double apparent reach through spinal extension; weed mantle spreads and copper tags flare cyan; recover original length.
design.death: Soul-light fades, long body collapses in two soft coils and tags settle into a stable heap.

design.identity: Mobile irregular coral colony, blue-violet branching coral crown, seafoam pores, charcoal rocky base; exactly four crablike supporting legs, three small grasping pale hands emerging from coral gaps.
design.attack: Rock far backward then thrust base and paired coral spikes toward LEFT, hands spear forward twice, brake and return.
design.cast: Fold coral branches inward and lower whole colony, then violently fan branches and all three grasping hands wide, release blue pressure rings; limbs return to original pores.
design.death: Hands retract, legs buckle, brittle coral branches break and settle on their rock base; stable broken colony.

design.identity: Thick giant tidal eel with strong S silhouette, mismatched interlocking tooth rows, ink-teal scales with one side desaturated pale grey, cyan dorsal fin, heavy coiled tail; no arms or legs.
design.attack: Tighten coil then a huge LEFT head-and-jaw lunge, three ripping jaw beats, withdraw through travelling spinal wave.
design.cast: Contract body into a low coil then rear neck very high, gape jaws fully, flare dorsal fin and project expanding cyan fear-pressure rings; body undulates back into coil.
design.death: Jaw slackens, fin folds and heavy body slowly collapses into a stable grounded side coil.

design.identity: Complete compact centipede baseline creature, five burgundy-purple chitin segments with central ivory notched stripe, smoke-violet joints, paired amber eyes, two mandibles, ten pale lilac legs and two tail pincers. Shell language matches front/middle/back segments.
design.attack: Curl front segments up, mandibles open then whip front body toward LEFT and retract, paired legs follow a travelling wave.
design.cast: Front braces, body coils into a pronounced C then rapidly expands through segment hinges, abdomen pulses twice; hind pairs stay grounded.
design.death: Segment tension collapses in sequence, legs curl inward and body rolls partially sideways, stable chitin corpse.

design.identity: Centipede FRONT section: three burgundy-purple chitin plates, continuous ivory notched dorsal stripe, smoke-violet hinges, amber paired eyes, horned head and two mandibles, six lilac legs; clean rounded rear socket on RIGHT. Same scale and stripe as middle/back.
design.attack: Rear socket braces while horned head rears then snaps mandibles hard toward LEFT twice; legs wave and recover.
design.cast: Compress three plates like a spring then rear head almost vertical, mandibles open extremely wide, hinge plates flare outward and amber gland pulse releases shock.
design.death: Head slumps, mandibles close and legs curl under, plates settle sideways, rear socket remains visible.

design.identity: Centipede MIDDLE section: three burgundy-purple chitin saddle plates, continuous ivory notched dorsal stripe, smoke-violet joints, six pale lilac legs, rounded front/rear sockets; no head eyes mouth or tail pincers. Same scale as front/back.
design.attack: Arch the middle plate very high, then slam and whip shell broadside toward LEFT; six legs alternate in travelling flexion and recover.
design.cast: Both end sockets hold while central plates form a huge inverted U arch then open accordion-wide and pulse amber at seams before settling.
design.death: Central shell tilts sideways, six legs fold inward and disconnected plate sockets settle into a stable corpse.

design.identity: Centipede BACK section: three tapering burgundy-purple chitin plates, continuous ivory notched dorsal stripe, smoke-violet joints, six pale lilac legs, twin long curved tail pincers on RIGHT, rounded front socket on LEFT. Same scale as front/middle.
design.attack: Brace front socket, swing tail far backward then whip twin pincers overhead to LEFT, snap them and return.
design.cast: Curl tail over shell into a large scorpionlike C, spread both pincers far apart, amber seams swell then a hard clamp shock releases; unwind.
design.death: Tail droops, pincers separate slackly, legs fold and abdomen rolls onto side into a stable corpse.

design.identity: Beehive shaman with smoky violet chitin head, amber compound eyes, burgundy hood-like thorax, black-green robe wings, hexagonal wax hive on back, two main arms holding ivory wax sigil and simple spear, two braced insect feet; six small amber bees orbit separately.
design.attack: Draw spear far behind shoulder, crouch, full-body LEFT spear thrust, antennae and hive follow through; withdraw spear.
design.cast: Bend antennae forward, raise wax sigil over head, open both robe wings very wide, arch abdomen and direct a large spiralling bee swarm toward LEFT; close wings and recover.
design.death: Swarm disperses, hive tilts, knees fold and shaman collapses on its side; spear and wax sigil remain beside body.

sourceIssues.error: 特效图包含完整巢蜂巫祝主体，会造成双影。

design.identity: Floating tall asymmetric triangular crystal prism with purple transparent facets, green parasite silhouette trapped at core, three offset shard fins and six long dark burgundy chitin root limbs curving around the prism; stable visible core, no humanoid legs.
design.attack: 封壳蓄势，根须收拢，随后前倾并向左刺出下方晶棱，回到悬浮。
design.cast: 晶壳层叠闭合聚光，再分瓣张开，露出狭窄绿光，最后闭合回到悬浮。
design.death: 绿芯闪烁熄灭，根须松开，紫晶外壳分裂并落为暗色残骸。

design.identity: Broad long-night knight in cold silver plate with dark crimson cloth, closed pointed visor, heavy shoulder pauldrons, exactly two armored boots, right hand iron chain flail with one dark meteor head and engraved links; left gauntlet holds a tall angular cold-silver kite shield with the same engraved dark center.
design.attack: Wind chain flail far behind helm, crouch and rotate hips, two wide successive LEFT flail swings with clearly tethered head, recoil and recover.
design.cast: Deep kneel, lift flail and left shield overhead, open chest in a huge war chant, crimson oath energy bursts and chain rings follow through; recover.
design.death: Flail falls first, knight drops to one knee then onto side, armor remains solid, head chain and handle settle together.

design.identity: Hollow complete cold silver knight armor with a very dim thread of blue soul light inside visor and joints, dark violet tattered tabard, pointed shoulder plates, two armored boots; right gauntlet holds one long narrow ghost-steel sword.
design.attack: Draw sword behind shoulder, bend knees and rotate hips into broad LEFT diagonal soul slash; sword stays gripped, recover.
design.cast: Bend empty helm down, pull sword across chest then open arms extremely wide, chest plates part slightly and three coils of dim cobalt soul fire pour forward; armor closes and resets.
design.death: Soul thread leaves visor and extinguishes, hollow plates detach and clatter into a stable empty armor heap, sword remains.

design.identity: Long-night knight in ivory and charcoal armor under a deep burgundy candle-pattern robe, closed thin visor, two boots below robe, candle crown with three small warm ivory flames, right gauntlet holds a short ritual staff with one wax candle. Candle flame is sole light source.
design.attack: Draw staff to shoulder, crouch then drive staff toward LEFT releasing a compact magic bomb, robe follows full torso turn; retract.
design.cast: Bow very low with staff crossed, then raise both arms high and sweep a wide circle, robe sleeves open fully, candle crown flames elongate and a huge ivory-purple magic orb forms then launches LEFT; recover.
design.death: Three crown candles extinguish one by one, knees buckle and robe folds over solid fallen armor, staff settles beside corpse.

design.identity: Heavy ancient balance-machine knight, oxidized cold steel and verdigris brass armor, exposed shoulder gears, ivory measurement scale marks, black-purple cloth, exactly two large mechanical boots, right forearm heavy cleaver, left forearm furnace nozzle with small orange core.
design.attack: Brace boots, lower hips, raise cleaver far overhead then full-body powerful LEFT heavy cleave, gears rotate and recover.
design.cast: Crouch as furnace loads, spread shoulders and open left nozzle, torso leans massively LEFT, vent a long orange-white flamethrower cone; valve shuts and return.
design.death: Gears jam, furnace goes dark, chassis drops to knee then heavy forward-side collapse, cleaver and nozzle remain attached.

design.identity: Tall obsidian-violet gothic sluice gate pillar with two cold-silver side pillars, a barred central opening packed with layered cyan soul faces, two hanging short chains and a heavy grounded stone pedestal; no humanoid legs.
design.attack: Gate tilts forward on pedestal hinge as bars open sharply and emit one concentrated cyan soul-burn spear LEFT; bars recoil shut.
design.cast: Compress soul faces behind bars, chains lift and spread, both side pillars hinge very wide, gate opens into a huge spiralling cyan-violet soul maelstrom then draws itself closed.
design.death: Soul faces leave in stages, chains go slack, bars crack and both pillars collapse onto pedestal as dark stable rubble.

sourceIssues.error: 独立特效改用无角色参考的魂流图集。

design.identity: Fern-armored woodland larva, overlapping moss plates, amber eyes, paired ivory hooks and one lilac spore bud.
design.idle: Shallow breathing ripple through the leaf plates over the planted rear belly.
design.attack: Compress, bite LEFT with extended ivory jaws, snap and retract.
design.cast: Coil up into an S shape and open the lilac spore bud, then lower and close the bud.
design.hit: Squint and draw the head into the leaf hood, then rebound to neutral.
design.death: Slump against the ground, close the eyes and lower the lilac bud.

design.identity: Large armored drill-headed worm, slate stone-grey body with forest moss, ringed shell segments, three spiralling ivory drilling mandibles around dark mouth, amber eyes, low heavy coiled rear body on soil; no humanoid limbs.
design.attack: Recoil drill head strongly then twist neck and drive spiral mandibles far LEFT, recoil through all shell rings and reset.
design.cast: Brace rear coil, rear drill head extremely high, three mandibles flare wide and neck rings counter-rotate as the worm roars, green-grey mineral pressure wave releases; lower and reset.
design.death: Mandibles stop turning, neck rings buckle and drill head falls sideways, body settles in a stable coil.

notes: 五类动作均为16个生成姿态；待机单独锁定原画接地区，允许其他关节清楚活动。
